title: Preview a scoped dynamic follow-up due report
description: A salesperson selects follow-up reminder evidence fields and an as-of date and ahead-day window, then previews a stable bounded page. Reuse the current-user menu and SalespersonDataScopeService policy established by the preceding task, with database-side scope, count, order and page limits before materialization. Add a finite field catalog, request and page DTO, server-side field projection, and a dedicated authorized API endpoint. Validate unknown or duplicate fields, aheadDays 0 to 365, page 1 or greater, pageSize 1 to 200 and optional due status before source reads; fail closed with clear errors. Return only selected fields, total, truncation and empty context; keep overdue, today and upcoming meanings and do not expose unrestricted records. OperationLogMiddleware audits preview calls. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused in-memory tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: A finite field catalog and bounded POST preview validate fields, due status, date and page limits before data reads and recheck current-user follow-up-due menu and salesperson scope on every call.

The preview uses a server-side scoped, stably ordered current page of follow-up evidence, projects only selected fields, and returns total, truncation and empty meaning without leaking unassigned or null-customer rows.
Focused tests cover field order, duplicate or unknown fields, status and date filters, page limits, scope revocation, empty pages and read-only operation; safe Release build/test passes.
